title: Scope 10: /tree branch summaries, /clone, and compaction proof
note: Paired clean native builds: base origin/develop aa83c51d89 in its own worktree, candidate 3e77d0897b (branch summaries, /clone, compaction proof tests). Standard suite, 7 models, 3 trials, 336 samples, all successful. The change alters what the model sees only after an interactive /tree navigation where the user chooses a summary: the branch summary request and the branchSummary message in later context. No headless scenario can drive /tree, so that path is covered by faux-provider and PTY tests, and its summarization prompts are Pi's byte for byte (tests/fixtures/pi-compaction/golden.json). This record shows the default model surface unchanged: tool schemas are identical on every model, and every first-request difference is the executable path in the docs line (the candidate's worktree name is 4 characters longer, named twice, hence +8 bytes), the temporary workspace directory, and prompt_cache_key. The one flag, gemini-3.8-flash-high tool errors 1 -> 2, is git run outside a repository in ordinary_edit and path_discovery, which happened in both arms; it is model-generated and unrelated to the change, and is accepted.

settings.effort: each route's effort is in routes: medium by default, DeepSeek high (it has no medium), and an EVAL_MODELS @<effort> replaces either

regressionRule: all tasks, per model: total tokens with the 95% interval above zero; requests up more than 10% with the 95% interval above zero; failures +2 or more; any tool-error increase
